title: Brisas Marinas
lyrics:
Brisas Marinas Song Package – Duet Ready (EN/Spanglish)
Song 1: "Brisas del Malecón"
Style for Suno: Uplifting tropical pop / dembow fusion, joyful male-female duet, beach sunset vibes, 336 Hz tuned, warm Nicaraguan essence, happy hardcore light touch, 130-140 BPM.
Length: Full structure (~3:30–4:00)
[Intro – Both]
(Soft waves + gentle guitar)
Brisas... Brisas del mar...
[Verse 1 – Female]
Down on the malecón where the Pacific kisses the shore,
Brisas Marinas waiting, open that door.
Fresh lobster grilled perfect, ceviche so bright,
Family around the table from morning till night.
[Verse 2 – Male]
Atardecer naranja pinta el cielo de fuego,
Camarones y pescado, el sabor es verdadero.
Nica Libre in my hand, laughter in the air,
40 meters north of Estrella, you’ll find us there.
[Pre-Chorus – Both]
Ven con los tuyos, reserva ya,
Mariscos frescos bajo el sol de SJDS...
[Chorus – Duet, Harmonies]
Brisas, Brisas del Malecón!
Sea breeze singing our song.
Lobster, ceviche, sunset glow,
Brisas Marinas, let the good times flow!
Mar y Tierra, hearts unite,
Family, friends, pure delight.
From dawn till the stars shine above,
Brisas Marinas — this is love!
[Verse 3 – Female]
Happy Hour starts at five, wings and cold beer,
Mini-nachos dancing, bring all your cheer.
Vegan options ready if you give us a call,
Cauliflower wings flying, best of all.
[Verse 4 – Male]
44 years of flavor on this beautiful bay,
Grandparents, kids, everyone wants to stay.
Pasta, steak, or mariscada grande,
Sunset views forever, life is sweet and dandy.
[Bridge – Both, building]
Waves keep rolling, memories we make,
One more toast for the journey, for the sake...
Of good food, good people, this magic place,
Brisas Marinas — feel the embrace!
[Final Chorus – Duet, bigger]
Brisas, Brisas del Malecón!
Sea breeze singing our song.
Lobster, ceviche, sunset glow,
Brisas Marinas, let the good times flow!
¡Ven ya! Come on down, don’t delay,
Malecón magic every single day!
[Outro – Both, fading with waves]
Brisas... Brisas del mar...
San Juan del Sur, we are yours...
